description: Clears one field worker's schedule change on a date (YYYY-MM-DD), so their normal weekly hours apply again, as Clear on the staff calendar does. To set a change, use set_staff_availability. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: clear_staff_availability_override
title: Clear a worker's schedule change for a date
